info.title: ClearWage API
info.description: Backend API for ClearWage — workforce management: staff, attendance, shifts, ledger, payroll, and more.

post.description: Accepts a Firebase ID token from phone auth, verifies it, and returns an app JWT.

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid token or unregistered phone

post.description: Accepts a Firebase ID token, name, and factory name. Creates a tenant + owner employee, returns app JWT.

get.description: Paginated list of employees. Supports search by name/phone (?q) and status filter (?status=active|inactive).
All ledger entries for the tenant in a date range.
Company-wide sum of (udhaar - jama) across all employees.

post.description: Creates an offsetting ledger entry to zero out the employee balance.

get.description: Monthly wage cost trend for the last N months.
Employees whose outstanding balance exceeds their monthly wage.
Today's attendance counts, daily jama total, total outstanding, and recent activity.

put.description: Approves the request and auto-creates an udhaar ledger entry.

post.description: Calculates wages, overtime, udhaar deductions, and net payable for all employees in a date range.
Makes attendance for the month read-only.
